= Configuration and env loaders

Libraries for loading and validating application configuration from environment
variables and config files.

* https://dotenvx.com/[dotenvx]
* https://github.com/mozilla/node-convict[node-convict]
* https://github.com/indexzero/nconf[nconf]
* https://github.com/node-config/node-config[node-config]
* https://github.com/dominictarr/rc[rc]
* https://github.com/cosmiconfig/cosmiconfig[cosmicconfig]
* https://github.com/evanshortiss/env-var[env-var]
